literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong lines 198-200 identifies Pac-Man as the yellow, pizza-shaped title character of the maze game. The answer options are all established video-game characters: Lara Croft is Tomb Raider’s main character (Strong lines 203, 210), Peach rules the Mushroom Kingdom (Nintendo line 15), and Sonic is Sega’s hedgehog character (Sega lines 29-31). The prompt uniquely describes Pac-Man.
literalGroups.locator: The Strong Pac-Man lines 195-200; The Strong Tomb Raider lines 203, 210; Play Nintendo Princess Peach lines 15-17; Sega Sonic history lines 29-40.

literalGroups.literal: Пакман — жёлтый персонаж в форме пиццы из аркадной игры-лабиринта. The Strong называет его знаковым представителем эпохи видеоигр.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong lines 198-200 describes the yellow pizza-shaped title character, the maze game, and Pac-Man’s cultural status as a video-game icon.

literalGroups.literal: Лара Крофт — археолог из Великобритании и главная героиня серии Tomb Raider.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong Tomb Raider lines 203 and 210 identifies Lara Croft as the series’ main character and describes the designers’ choice to make her a British archaeologist.

literalGroups.literal: В Японии Pac-Man был известен под названием Puck Man.
literalGroups.primaryGround: The Strong line 195 says Pac-Man was known in Japan as Puck Man; the note adds this own-option alias beyond the prompt and key.

literalGroups.literal: Принцесса Пич правит Грибным королевством и играет в спортивные игры с друзьями.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Play Nintendo lines 15-17 identifies Princess Peach as ruler of the Mushroom Kingdom and says she plays sports with friends.

literalGroups.literal: Соник стал лицом Sega; его первая игра вышла в 1991 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Sega lines 27-31 says Sonic became the face of Sega and that the first Sonic the Hedgehog adventure was released in 1991.
